artifact:
Feature: Admin Functionality for Labs, Chemists, Specialities, and Doctors

  Scenario: Admin adds a lab and a chemist
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new lab with name "Lab A" and location "Location A"
    And the admin adds a new chemist with name "Chemist A" and lab "Lab A"
    Then the lab "Lab A" should be added to the system
    And the chemist "Chemist A" should be added to the system

  Scenario: Admin updates doctor information
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a doctor with name "Doctor A" and speciality "Speciality A"
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Doctor B"
    Then the doctor's name should be updated to "Doctor B"

  Scenario: Maintain Specialities
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "Speciality A"
    Then the speciality "Speciality A" should be added to the system

  Scenario: Add a new (unique) Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "Speciality A"
    Then the speciality "Speciality A" should be added to the system

  Scenario: View and Update the details of an existing Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a speciality with name "Speciality A"
    When the admin updates the speciality's name to "Speciality B"
    Then the speciality's name should be updated to "Speciality B"

  Scenario: Delete the Speciality - A Speciality can be deleted only if no doctors are attached to it
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a speciality with name "Speciality A" and no doctors attached
    When the admin deletes the speciality "Speciality A"
    Then the speciality "Speciality A" should be deleted from the system

  Scenario: Delete the Speciality - A Speciality cannot be deleted if doctors are attached to it
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a speciality with name "Speciality A" and a doctor attached
    When the admin tries to delete the speciality "Speciality A"
    Then the speciality "Speciality A" should not be deleted and an error message should be displayed

  Scenario: Maintain Doctors and Associate them with the Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And there is a speciality with name "Speciality A"
    When the admin adds a new doctor with name "Doctor A" and speciality "Speciality A"
    Then the doctor "Doctor A" should be added to the system and associated with the speciality "Speciality A"
